data.training_observation_schedule: one observation per physical record per epoch per row; 20 fresh shared-latent namespaces; full/res alternative views replace quotas

permissions.regime: Source-only paired self-supervised restoration fitting; sourceV labels only independent readout and explicitly assisted selection B
permissions.query_use: At most two unique source-frozen candidates; independent per-row seven-view predictions before scorer opens existing truth
permissions.claim_scope: Terrestrial received-observation recovery under native added-channel proxy; no true-TX/real-in-orbit claim; fixed1200 diagnostic and one model seed cannot prove stable final lowurban>60%

checkpoint.initialization: All6 restorers scratch; no inherited restoration weights
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing cleanF E200 and AsF T1 E20+10 source_contract and complete scratch-parent lineage; exact local source roles matched; frozen.py
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Existing two frozen F/default heads reuse verified identical source-role lineage from parent run; parent cache only contains source inputs. No target-trained/selected state inherited.

selection_rule.waveform: No TX/F inputs: clean NMSE<=.02 then minimum mean raw IQ NMSE on original six residual sourceV views; fixed row order tie; if none minimum clean NMSE
selection_rule.identity_assisted: Separately disclosed labeled sourceV selection: best AsF lowurban among qualified rows; no label loss in restorer training

execution.gpu_policy: Physical0/1/5; max3 own GPU workers, max1/card; all-owner cap2/card and12GB free; existing shared capacity lock; other healthy tasks untouched
execution.stop_rule: Nonfinite loss/gradient/output, mismatched source/latent pair, missing input, output collision, checkpoint mismatch or invalid prediction coverage: stop row/prevent unstarted rows; preserve healthy active rows; no automatic retry

metrics_plan.primary: Primary frozen AsF/default-head lowurban, clean and net corrections; full/residual source results separate. Pure waveform policy A and labeled-V-assisted policy B disclosed separately, frozen before target.

notes: Data contrast uses identical UNet init, model seed, epoch exposures, optimizer and loss; route is the only difference across first3 rows.
Architecture contrast uses same mixed source observation stream; parameters, network evaluations and latency reported, no claim all costs equal.
No clean detector/quality router; no pre_sync synchronizer. All clean inputs pass the same restored-IQ path.
Complex frequency mirror index is(-k)%N; bounded multiplicative main/image spectral correction followed by temporal UNet; task adaptation, not exact paper replication.
Generative condition encoder reused once per observation and injected every scale/step; v/flow targets independently audited; main16-step sampler, never clean-constructed inference.
Physics-unrolled, hybrid residual generation, L identity fine-tuning, F joint tuning, pre_sync, external model-family proof remain explicitly deferred, not silently claimed implemented.
